concerns.text: The plan requires running ≥800 float‑32 forward passes of Stable Diffusion 2.1 (or a comparable DiT) on a CPU‑only GitHub Actions runner. Generating that many images on CPU exceeds the typical 6‑hour runtime limit of the free CI environment, making the pipeline infeasible without guaranteed GPU resources. The “optional GPU‑escape hatch to Kaggle” is an implementation assumption, not a proven fallback, and the plan does not detail how the CI will automatically off‑load the workload. This violates the free‑compute constraint of llmXive.
